paper_role: dispatch-fusion kill test after the exact split cache path reduced traffic but failed the H1e wall-time gate
question: Can an XLA optimization barrier preserve the existing predictor-to-BF16-to-Euler contract inside one scalar-only skip NEFF, removing one dispatch per skipped step without changing the cache algorithm?

frozen_system.schedule: FLUX.1-dev 50-step dynamically shifted FlowMatch Euler sigmas
frozen_system.predictor: unchanged order-1 TaylorSeer/index-coordinate K=2 linear extrapolation
frozen_system.reference_contract: predict in FP32, round prediction to BF16, then latent.float() + delta_sigma * prediction.float(), round latent to BF16
frozen_system.candidate_skip_path: one cache_skip_step_barrier entry point receiving two FP32 coefficients and one FP32 delta sigma

gates.F1_compile: The four-entry application must compile and load on Trainium TP4 with the XLA barrier present in the skip graph.
gates.F2_exact_contract: Every one of 50 latent states and the final latent must be bit-exact to the frozen host BF16-boundary contract; agreement only with the fused-FP32 reference is failure.
gates.F3_single_dispatch: Each of all 38 skipped steps must execute exactly one cache skip entry point, not separate predictor and scheduler entry points.
gates.F4_scalar_boundary: Each skip may receive only two coefficients and one delta sigma from host; no full prediction or latent tensor crosses the host boundary.
gates.F5_latency_direction: Report paired steady-state single-skip latency against the already measured split path. This metric is diagnostic and does not authorize an end-to-end speed claim.

decision.if_pass: Integrate this exact fused skip entry point into the real H1e A12 path and rerun a quick paired end-to-end timing gate before any full 24-pair confirmation.
decision.if_fail: Reject optimization-barrier fusion; do not alter the cache algorithm to obtain a favorable speed number. Evaluate a persistent device loop or an explicitly versioned numerical contract separately.
